snippet.title: 🍗 5 Secret Biryani Cooking Tips for Restaurant-Style Flavor! 🤯🔥 #shorts
snippet.description:
Try these 5 amazing biryani cooking tips to make your homemade biryani more flavorful, aromatic and delicious. 🍗🍚


🍚 Make Biryani Rice Fluffy
Add a little lemon juice and oil to the boiling water before cooking rice. This can help keep the grains separate and give your biryani a beautiful texture.

✨ Add Royal Biryani Aroma
Before placing the biryani on dum, drizzle a little kewra water and saffron-infused milk over the rice. This creates a rich, aromatic fragrance.

🍗 Enhance Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
While cooking the chicken masala, add fried onion paste and crushed mint leaves. These ingredients add depth, color and authentic biryani flavor.

🔥 Prevent Biryani from Burning
Place a heavy, heat-safe tawa underneath the biryani pot while cooking on low heat. It helps distribute heat more evenly and reduces the chances of the bottom layer burning.

🧅 Make Crispy Fried Onions
Sprinkle a little salt and cornstarch over sliced onions before frying. This helps create crispy, golden-brown onions for your biryani.

snippet.description:
「うめきたの森」に、ちいかわパークストアなどが入るルクアサウス2期のオープンなど先週・今週だけでも、めまぐるしく変わる大阪・梅田エリア。

JR大阪駅の周辺や、茶屋町エリアの再開発が進む一方、長い間“ほぼそのまま”残されていたのが、1981年に誕生したビッグマン。45年たった今、画面の大きさは変わりましたが、建物自体は変わっていません。

そんな阪急大阪梅田駅周辺についに持ち上がった再開発プロジェクト。その名も『芝田1丁目計画』です。

計画では、大阪新阪急ホテル（閉館）、阪急ターミナルビル、阪急大阪梅田駅、阪急三番街（北館・南館）が順次、整備されます。

“取り残された一等地”とも言えるこのエリアの行く末とは…。MBS米澤飛鳥解説委員のプレゼンです。

snippet.title: Orang Tak Dikenal Tahu Nama Anakmu? Jangan Percaya, Tanyakan Kata Sandi!! #informatif #faktaunik
snippet.description:
Seorang anak dipanggil dengan namanya oleh orang yang belum pernah ia temui. Orang itu mengaku disuruh ibunya menjemput. Anak mudah percaya, karena orang yang tahu namanya terasa seperti kenalan keluarga, padahal nama itu bisa dibaca siapa saja dari tulisan di tas, botol minum, atau seragamnya.

Cara memastikannya adalah kata sandi keluarga: satu kata yang disepakati di rumah dan hanya diberitahukan orang tua kepada orang yang benar-benar disuruh menjemput. Orang yang tidak bisa menyebutkannya bukan suruhan orang tua. Anak tidak perlu mendekat atau berdebat, cukup menjauh dan kembali ke guru atau orang dewasa yang ia percaya, lalu orang tua ditelepon.

Kejadian nyata: 7 November 2018 di San Tan Valley, Arizona, seorang pria bermobil SUV putih berkata kepada anak perempuan 10 tahun bahwa saudara-saudaranya kecelakaan dan ia harus ikut. Anak itu menanyakan kata sandi keluarga. Pria itu tidak tahu, lalu pergi (Pinal County Sheriff's Office, diberitakan Fox 10 Phoenix dan ABC15, 11 November 2018).

Rujukan: Seattle Public Schools, disadur dari bagian pencegahan kejahatan Kepolisian Seattle (kata sandi keluarga untuk penjemput yang tidak biasa); Rodriguez dan Jackson 2020, Behavior Analysis in Practice (pelatihan kata sandi pada lima anak, penelitian kecil); Clark County Children's Justice Center (kata sandi mudah diingat, tidak mudah ditebak, diganti sesudah terpakai); University of Texas at Austin, Youth Protection Program (nama yang terlihat di barang anak); National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, KidSmartz (cek dulu, beri tahu orang dewasa yang dipercaya); Kidpower (keterbatasan kata sandi).

snippet.title: The Scientist Nobody Was Watching | Udit Chawla  - Raj Shamani #shorts
snippet.description:
Udit Chawla (@wellwithudit), founder of @wellwith.official, a consumer wellness brand built around Himalayan sea buckthorn. He identified an opportunity in an ingredient that had remained relatively underutilised despite its nutritional potential and set out to turn it into a mainstream consumer product. His entrepreneurial journey is an example of how founders can discover opportunities in overlooked ingredients rather than entering highly competitive product categories.

Udit's approach to building WellWith began with identifying a unique ingredient, understanding its market potential and finding ways to introduce it to consumers. His discovery process involved unexpected sources of inspiration, including a taxi driver in Ladakh, a speech by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and research patents sitting unused in scientific institutions. Instead of immediately chasing large-scale distribution, he focused on validating the product, understanding customer behaviour and building demand through direct interactions.

In This Episode, Udit Chawla shares the story of a Padma Shri-awarded scientist whose work had received surprisingly little attention online. He highlights the gap between extraordinary scientific contributions and the visibility they receive, showing why important work can go unnoticed.

snippet.title: Un hombre quedó 3 días atrapado en el fondo del océano… y salió vivo 🌊
snippet.description:
Unos buzos bajaron a sacar cuerpos de un barco hundido hace casi 3 días… y una mano agarró a uno de ellos 🌊

En 2013, una ola dio vuelta al remolcador Jascon-4 frente a Nigeria y lo hundió boca abajo a 30 metros. El cocinero, Harrison Okene, había ido al baño y quedó adentro, a oscuras. Nadando a ciegas encontró una oficina con aire atrapado, de algo más de un metro de alto: como el barco estaba al revés, el piso pasó a ser el techo, y el aire, que siempre sube, quedó encerrado entre la chapa y el agua. Es lo mismo que pasa con un vaso boca abajo que hundes en una alberca.

🫧 Al respirar soltaba dióxido de carbono: ese aire le alcanzaba para unas 56 horas, y lo ayudó que parte del gas se disolviera en el agua.
🍾 No lo podían subir de golpe: su cuerpo había absorbido gas por la presión y pasó dos días y medio en una cámara de descompresión.

De 12 hombres, sobrevivió uno solo: el que se levantó para ir al baño.

¿Tú hubieras aguantado casi 3 días a oscuras en el fondo del mar? 👇

snippet.title: Lula declarou guerra ao mercado financeiro e quem vai pagar a conta é você
snippet.description:
🧠 Aprenda a investir comigo no Brasil e no mundo: https://sard.ink/576-AUVP

O mercado tá querendo F*DER o Lula? O dólar bateu R$ 6, o Lula chamou a turma da Faria Lima de “yuppies” e veio a acusação de que o mercado financeiro tava fazendo terrorismo. Mas quem é esse tal de mercado? Se você comprou dólar pra viajar pra Disney, você também entrou nessa conta.

Pra entender por que o dólar subiu, eu fui olhar quem comprou e quem vendeu dólar futuro na B3 no primeiro pregão depois do segundo turno. Os estrangeiros ficaram do lado comprador, enquanto bancos e fundos ficaram do lado vendedor. Se a Faria Lima tava toda combinada pra fazer o dólar disparar, como é que essa conta fecha?
Por que o dólar subiu?

Tem importador comprando dólar pra trazer produto, empresa pagando dívida lá fora e investidor usando dólar futuro pra proteger o dinheiro que já tem no Brasil. Do outro lado, tem exportador trazendo dólar pro país. Eu te mostro como essas decisões mexem na cotação e por que os leilões do Banco Central têm efeito limitado.

E o Lula nessa história? Aí entram as contas públicas, o tamanho do ajuste fiscal e as dúvidas sobre quem vai comandar a Fazenda. A gente também vai olhar pros juros dos Estados Unidos, pro preço das commodities e pro que aconteceu com o dólar nos primeiros mandatos do próprio Lula. O que veio de fora e o que foi problema daqui?

Agora, se o dólar disparou e você tá doido pra mexer na carteira, olha primeiro pro que tá na sua mão. A cotação você não escolhe. O tamanho da sua reserva de emergência, quanto você aporta por mês e como divide seus investimentos, sim.

snippet.title: Is Canada Breaking With the Pentagon?
snippet.description:
On November 23, the US Defense Department released an unusually blunt fact sheet saying Canada falls short as a credible partner in defending North America. It says Ottawa has no fully costed plan to reach NATO's new 5% target and pushes its biggest increases past the 2029 election, that fewer than half of Canada's air force fleet was serviceable last year, and it criticises Canada's review of its planned 88 F-35s, as Ottawa looks at Sweden's Gripen. Prime Minister Mark Carney said last year that Canada should no longer send three-quarters of its defence capital spending to America. Ottawa had not replied to the fact sheet at the time of production. Is Canada breaking with the Pentagon, or driving a harder bargain?

The spending, readiness and F-35 points are the Pentagon fact sheet's claims. The Hegseth directive on contacts with Canada is as reported.

≠≠≠≠≠≠≠≠≠≠≠≠≠≠ Dustin Nickerson
A Seattle native now suffering in Southern California, Dustin Nickerson is an in-demand comic on the rise. In 2020, he released his debut comedy special, "Overwhelmed," which is currently one of the highest-rated specials on Amazon Prime Video.

In addition, he’s been featured on Comedy Central and Netflix by Kevin Hart, the Late Late Show with James Corden, Fox, and Hulu, and can regularly be heard on Sirius Radio XM. 

His stand-up clips and jokes have received tens of millions of views online, and his podcast, Don’t Make Me Come Back There, has over a million downloads.
He’s also the author of "How to be Married to Melissa," an Amazon #1 New Release published by Harper Collins in June 2022.

Dustin describes himself as “the world’s most average person” but is far from it when on stage. He brings you into his life through his jokes about the struggles of parenting, marriage, and being generally annoyed by most people.

At 38 years old, Dustin has been married for 18 years and has three kids. This helps Dustin truly become one of the most unique voices in the comedy scene.
